mapper.select: SELECT role_code FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND effective_start_date <= current_date AND (effective_end_date IS NULL OR effective_end_date >= current_date) ORDER BY role_code
mapper.update: UPDATE user_role SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = current_timestamp WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
